text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Man, we sang our hearts out~! Singing karaoke really got me pumped up, so today's training is gonna be a breeze—

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if it isn't Kita-chan!
We're about to hold the 'Neighborhood Enka Contest,'
so do stay and listen if you'd like!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
“Town Enka Contest”...!?
Whoa~! Let's go watch!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Haaah.
"Turf and Tears" really is a masterpiece, isn't it~!
choice_data_list: Tears... Are they mine, from getting stood up for practice?
Tears... I wonder if they're mine, from getting stood up for practice?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Is it that late already!?
I'm so, so sorrryyyyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, I gave a gentle warning to Kitasan Black, who seemed to have genuinely lost track of time.
